description_en: Configures multiple domain names at a time
name: BatchSetLiveDomainConfigs

parameters.description_en: The domain names that you want to batch configure. Supported domain names include ingest domains, main streaming domains, and sub-streaming domains. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh: 需要进行批量配置的域名。取值可以是推流域名、主播流域名或子播流域名。多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
